text:
Prisoner without a horizon

I hear the noises of the street

And see only a hostile sky

And the white wall of my prison


Evening flees through my cell

A sweet lamp burns

We are alone in my cell

Beautiful light, beloved reason

translation.title: Prisoner Without a Horizon
